records.text: Sigmund Freud was a Satanist who created a social science.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I told you Sigmund Freud was a Satanist. He created a social science.

verification.notes: Transcript reviewed. Freud founded psychoanalysis, but authoritative biographical sources describe him as atheist or secular and provide no evidence that he was a Satanist. Calling psychoanalysis social science is also imprecise; the composite statement combines a real intellectual role with an unsupported label.

sources.title: Formative Years — Sigmund Freud: Conflict & Culture — Library of Congress
sources.relevance: Identifies Freud neurological and psychoanalytic work and describes his secular life.

sources.title: Freud and Religion — Freud Museum London
sources.relevance: Documents Freud atheism, contrary to the unsupported Satanist label.

records.text: Elites practice occult sex magic
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Look, the short and the thick of it is the elites practice occult sex magic. You just got to accept.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. This is a sweeping assertion about undefined 'elites'; current-source searches found no bounded, testable proposition or credible evidence capable of verifying it.

records.text: Aleister Crowley hosted occult sex-magic parties around the world
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: It's right there in your face. If you just look into history a tiny bit and Aleister Crowley, who was once termed the world's wickedest man, would host these parties all across the world.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Scholarly histories document Crowley's sexual-magick practices and international occult networks, but do not establish the episode's sweeping formulation that he hosted occult sex-magic parties 'across the world.'

sources.title: The Sorcerer and His Apprentice
sources.relevance: Scholarly history of Crowley's magical practice and Abbey.

records.text: Benito Mussolini expelled Aleister Crowley from Italy for being a Satanist
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: OK, what ended up happening was Mussolini, the evil fascist, kicked him out of the country for being a Satanist.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Scholarship confirms Mussolini's government expelled Crowley from Italy in 1923 amid scandal surrounding the Abbey, but 'for being a Satanist' is not the documented official reason.

sources.title: The Sorcerer and His Apprentice
sources.relevance: Scholarly account confirms the 1923 expulsion amid sensational press coverage.

records.text: Jack Parsons was Aleister Crowley’s protégé and conducted occult sex rituals intended to create a “moon child”
